Estera tools

Three products. One platform.

WhatsApp, phone, and outbound prospecting, all in one place. Estera handles every channel automatically so you never miss a customer.

Capabilities

Everything you need to handle every customer touchpoint.

From first message to confirmed booking, Estera handles every step automatically, so nothing falls through the cracks.

Estera Voice

Your AI receptionist on the phone.

Estera Voice answers every call, takes messages, books appointments, and qualifies callers, like a human receptionist but always on.

Answers calls 24/7

No missed call, regardless of opening hours or call volume.

Books appointments automatically

Reserves slots directly from the call without involving your team.

50+ languages available

Speaks fluently with customers from any country, no extra setup.

Estera Concierge

WhatsApp conversations on autopilot.

Estera Concierge takes over every WhatsApp message, replies instantly, and manages bookings so you never miss a customer.

Instant replies

Responds in seconds to every WhatsApp message, at any hour.

Qualifies and books

Detects customer intent and books appointments directly from the conversation.

Keeps full context

Remembers every customer's history for personalized responses.

Different industries. Same AI.

Wherever customers have questions at any hour, Estera answers. Configured for your industry, ready in minutes.
